our_title: Strategy parameter set twice leaks the first sub-strategy
ran: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$INFRA/asan/lib repro/common/st_pristine 'm{asc=b{bnd=f,org=f},asc=b{bnd=f,org=f}}' -> ret=0, 'Direct leak of 104 byte(s) ... parser_yy.y:288' + 208 indirect; 'b{bnd=f,bnd=f}' same. Patched: ret=0, no leak.
evidence: '*((Strat **) (...)) = ($2);' overwrites the slot without freeing its previous value (default &stratdummy is handled by stratExit, parser.c:152-153).

fix_options.label: A. stratExit() the previous slot value before storing (recommended)
fix_options.tested: Built, leak gone, valid strategies unchanged, check targets pass.
fix_options.tradeoffs: stratExit(&stratdummy) and stratExit(NULL) are no-ops, so safe for every default.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Three lines in his style; alternative (reject duplicates with an error) would change accepted input.

fix_options.label: B. Reject a parameter given twice
fix_options.summary: Track set parameters per method and errorPrint on a repeat.
fix_options.tested: untested: not written; would need per-method state in ParserEnv.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Behaviour change for currently accepted strings.

our_title: Column numbers are 1-based on line 1 and 0-based on later lines
ran: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$INFRA/asan/lib repro/common/st_pristine 'r{sep=m{asc=b{x}}}' -> 'line 1, column 15' (15th char); "$(printf 'r{\nsep=m{asc=b{x}}}')" -> 'line 2, column 12' (13th char of line 2). Patched: 'line 2, column 13'; multi-line case 'line 4, column 3'.
evidence: 'locaptr->coennum = 0;' after a newline, while parser_yy.y:100-103 initialises '@$.cobenum = @$.libenum = @$.coennum = @$.liennum = 1;'.

fix_options.label: A. Reset the column to 1 (recommended)
fix_options.tested: Built; columns now 1-based on every line; check targets pass.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Column numbers in messages for multi-line strategies shift by one (they were wrong).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: One token, same loop he fixed in a94688c.

fix_options.label: B. Make all columns 0-based
fix_options.tradeoffs: Changes every existing message (line 1 columns), and 1-based is the convention of editors.

our_title: Three strategy tables leave a strategy parameter NULL: unset parameter crashes method and stratSave
ran: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$INFRA/asan/lib $WORK/build/bin/gmap src/check/data/bump.grf c4.tgt /dev/null -Mr'{sep=m{asc=b,low=b}}' -> 'WARNING: stratParserParse: strategy parameter "org" of method "b" not set' then 'AddressSanitizer: SEGV ... #0 _SCOTCHbgraphBipartSt bgraph_bipart_st.c:299 #1 _SCOTCHbgraphBipartBd bgraph_bipart_bd.c:117'; st_pristine 'r{sep=m{asc=b,low=b}}' -> SEGV in stratSave (parser.c:195 via :254). Table audit (repro/PS2-G04-strategy-parser-3/audit_defaults.py): 3 mismatches (bgraph bd, bdgraph bd, hdgraph nd), 0 after the patch. Patched gmap: mapping completes, '-vs' prints 'b{bnd=,org=,width=3}'.
read_only: hdgraph_order_nd.c:419 (osq -> hdgraphOrderSq2 with NULL) and bdgraph_bipart_bd.c:129 (stratorg NULL) read only: PT-Scotch run with a hand-written strategy not exercised; same code pattern as the sequential crash.
why_not_run: the sequential instance reproduces the mechanism; the distributed twins are the same missing initialiser
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/bgraph_bipart_st.c:96, src/libscotch/bdgraph_bipart_st.c:84, src/libscotch/hdgraph_order_st.c:81 (defaults); src/libscotch/parser_yy.y:308-318 (warning only); src/libscotch/parser.c:254 (stratSave dereferences the NULL slot); bgraph_bipart_bd.c:117/217/420/507, bdgraph_bipart_bd.c:129/184/253, hdgraph_order_nd.c:276/419 (consumers)
evidence: bgraph_bipart_st.c:96 '} bgraphbipartstdefaultbd = { { 3, &stratdummy } };' for a BgraphBipartBdParam {distmax, stratbnd, stratorg} (bgraph_bipart_bd.h:57-61) -> stratorg NULL; kgraph_map_st.c:96 has '{ { 3, &stratdummy, &stratdummy } }'. hdgraph_order_st.c:81 '{ { &stratdummy, &stratdummy, &stratdummy } }' for 4 fields (hdgraph_order_nd.h:59-64). parser_yy.y:314 only errorPrintW's 'strategy parameter ... not set'.

fix_options.label: A. Add the missing &stratdummy defaults (recommended)
fix_options.summary: Three initialisers completed so that an unset strategy parameter is the empty strategy, as for every other method.
fix_options.tested: Built 32/64-bit (0 warnings); gmap reproducer completes; stratSave prints 'org='; audit script 0 mismatches; check targets pass.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Touches bgraph_bipart_st.c, bdgraph_bipart_st.c, hdgraph_order_st.c (files outside this group: coordinate with their owners).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: The warning in the parser exists precisely to catch a table lacking a default (every other table has one); this is the fix he would make.

fix_options.label: B. Make 'strategy parameter not set' a parser error
fix_options.summary: errorPrint + YYABORT instead of errorPrintW in the STRATMETHOD final action.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Prevents the crash for any future table mistake, but turns a warning into a hard error and does not give the method a usable default.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Possible hardening on top of A; alone it leaves the tables wrong.

our_title: last_resort/parser_yy.c and parser_lh.h are stale: YY_NO_UNISTD_H from 31f6197 missing

evidence: last_resort/parser_yy.c:130 'to   : 11 sep 2024' vs parser_yy.y:55 'to   : 25 sep 2026'; the Windows portability define added by 31f6197 is absent from the fallback parser.

our_title: Double constants in saved test expressions printed with %lf lose precision
ran: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$INFRA/asan/lib repro/common/st_pristine '/(vert>0.1234567)?r;' -> '(/((vert)>(0.123457))?...' (value changed on re-parse). Same with the patched tree (not addressed).

fix_options.label: A. Print with '%.17g' (round-trip exact)
fix_options.summary: Use a format that preserves the double value.
fix_options.tested: untested: not written; format choice is the maintainer's (changes every saved double).
fix_options.tradeoffs: Longer, uglier numbers in saved strategies.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Decision for the maintainer; reported, not patched.
